description: Search one app's reviews in one storefront by text, star rating, app version and date range, newest first — up to 1,000 rows from the full review archive within your plan's review window. `total` is the match count; `truncated` tells you when more rows matched than you asked for.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

q.description: text to find in the review title or body

version.description: app version the review was written on, e.g. 2.4.0

name: search_reviews
